title: Penalty Kick: One Shot, Two Inputs, Five Rounds of Mounting Pressure
subtitle: A rebuild of Penalty World Cup 2026 as a minimal shoot-aim loop: aim parameters feed a probability model, every miss scores for the keeper, and a five-round sprint decides the match. Fully playable demo at the end.

breakdown.title: Rule Skeleton
bullets: Four-state machine: boot → menu → gameplay → result, with instant rematch and menu return
Five penalty rounds per match, one kick each: a goal scores for the player, a save or miss scores for the AI
After five rounds the scores are compared: player wins, AI wins, or draw
Aiming is just two parameters — angle and power; defaults are angle 0, power 50

breakdown.title: Behavior Loop
bullets: Set angle/power → hit Shoot → the probability model resolves goal / save / miss on the spot
Every miss hands the keeper a point, so the score seesaws and pressure rises with each round
On the result screen, Play Again resets everything for a rematch; Main Menu exits to the menu

breakdown.title: Implementation Notes
bullets: penalty/physics-engine resolves shots analytically: 0.7 × (1 − |angle|/45 × 0.5) × power/100, clamped to 0.1–0.9
The shot.take event drives simulateShot, which resolves, scores, and advances the round synchronously, emitting game.over after round 5
Module split: common-ui for buttons, aim-controller for inputs, physics-engine for resolution, audio-manager as the audio hook
Presentation left as placeholder: the 3D scene container and scoreboard are static in this build — the rule pipeline comes first

demo.note: Hit Start Match, then click Shoot through five penalty rounds: each kick is resolved instantly by the angle/power probability model, every miss scores for the keeper, and the final score decides the match. One-click rematch included.
